poster_title: Query-Based Router by Dual Contrastive Learning for Assembling Large Language Models
authors: Shuhao Chen, Weisen Jiang, Baijiong Lin, James T. Kwok, Yu Zhang
paper_info: Southern University of Science and Technology, The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, 2023

panels.headline: Complementary strengths of LLMs
content: LLMs excel in various tasks, but strengths vary.
Need for effective routing to harness collective power.
Existing methods ineffective for multiple high-performing LLMs.

panels.headline: RouterDC with dual contrastive losses
content: Sample-LLM contrastive loss pulls query close to top LLMs.
Sample-sample contrastive loss clusters similar queries.
panels.figure_caption: The inference pipeline of RouterDC. The encoder E and the LLM embeddings k's are trainable parameters, while the LLMs are frozen.

panels.headline: Challenging reasoning tasks
content: Evaluated on language understanding, code generation, and mathematical reasoning.
Compared with individual top-performing LLMs and existing routing methods.
panels.figure_caption: Visualization of embeddings of training queries.

panels.headline: Accuracy improvement +2.76%
content: Outperformed individual top-performing LLMs and existing routing methods.
Achieved state-of-the-art performance in assembling LLMs.
panels.figure_caption: Testing accuracy of candidate LLMs and our RouterDC on in-distribution and out-of-distribution tasks.

panels.headline: Efficient and effective router
content: RouterDC effectively harnesses the complementary potentials of LLMs.
Proposed dual contrastive losses beneficial for training the router.
RouterDC is parameter-efficient, computation-efficient, and inference-efficient.
